case_number: 2025 INSC 60; CONTEMPT PETITION (C) OF 2025 [@DIARY NO. 20329 OF 2020]
summary: Contempt petitions alleging non-compliance with 2017 absorption order; petitioners not parties to original appeal; no in personam direction for salary arrears; fact-finding required on actual work period; pension payment issue distinct from salary; directions issued for Registrar/Vice Chancellor to adjudicate claims within three months; excess recovery permitted; High Court remedy preserved.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Bihar & others vs Bihar Rajya M.S.E.S.K.K.M & others (2005) 9 SCC 129
final_judgment: Contempt petitions disposed of with directions for university authorities to adjudicate salary/pension claims; Registrar/Vice Chancellor to conduct discrete enquiry; pension claims to be decided notionally uninfluenced by prior contempt orders.
